scientific_integrity: The displayed explicit curve and normal-bundle exact sequences provide a uniform mathematical proof. Exact-integer finite checks are supplementary and do not establish the infinite theorem. No assertion of independent review, publication, or certified uniqueness is made.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers the degree/dimension family \(d=4k-1\) in \(\operatorname{Gr}(2,3k+1)\) for \(k\ge2\) over \(\mathbf C\); not all rational-curve degrees, not positive characteristic, and not individual nongeneral curves. Dependence on irreducibility of parameter spaces and the rational normal curve resolution is explicit; independent validation and exhaustive literature searches have not been performed.
title: Balanced normal bundles at the first numerical threshold in \(\operatorname{Gr}(2,3k+1)\)
